claude.sample_unit: retained model runs (100 de-identified acute stroke cases x 144 conditions)
models_evaluated: Gemini (four models, including lower-cost and frontier variants)

links.outcome: NIHSS scoring error under context stress (length, distractors, information position)
links.effect: Structured retrieval reduced MAE from 4.58 to 2.96 points versus non-agentic baselines, implying baseline performance degraded under realistic chart stress; gains consistent across all 36 stress combinations.
links.quote: Structured retrieval reduces mean absolute error (MAE) from 4.58 to 2.96 points relative to non-agentic baselines (mean gain 1.62 MAE points; 95% CI 1.57–1.67; 35% relative reduction), with consistent gains across all 36 stress combinations.

links.outcome: NIHSS scoring MAE with structured retrieval versus non-agentic baselines
links.effect: MAE fell from 4.58 to 2.96 points (mean gain 1.62; 95% CI 1.57–1.67; 35% relative reduction); tool-retrieved pipelines outperformed RAG in 33 of 36 combinations.
links.quote: Structured retrieval reduces mean absolute error (MAE) from 4.58 to 2.96 points relative to non-agentic baselines (mean gain 1.62 MAE points; 95% CI 1.57–1.67; 35% relative reduction), with consistent gains across all 36 stress combinations.

unlisted_practices: Using tool-based agentic structured retrieval instead of full-context input to improve LLM robustness to long, noisy charts
